approach: Add one bullet to crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md and one to critic.md. Trim a few redundant words from each file so each frame stays under 500 estimated tokens, which means at most 1497 bytes. Add one unit test in the athena-context test module that asserts the fixed wording in PLANNER_FRAME.text and CRITIC_FRAME.text. Copy the new planner and critic sizes into docs/system-facts.md, because an existing test fails otherwise. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry. No code logic changes and no records are touched.

decisions.choice: Trim redundant text in planner.md and critic.md to make room, and keep the frame-size test unchanged.
decisions.reason: planner_and_critic_frames_are_short_and_fit_the_budgets asserts estimate_tokens(frame.text) < 500, and estimate_tokens is ceil(bytes/3), so a frame may be at most 1497 bytes. planner.md is 1439 bytes and critic.md is 1369, so the new bullets do not fit without trimming. Planner trims: drop the last bullet 'End with the plan as structured output.' (contract rule 8 already says it) and shorten the working-directory sentence. Critic trims: drop the closing line and shorten the snapshot sentence.

rejected.why: Token budgets are out of scope, and the limit keeps the frames short.

rejected.option: Put the convention in the planner brief (briefs.rs) instead of the frame.
rejected.why: The request and criteria name the prompt files, and briefs.rs is not a deliverable.

decisions.choice: One new bullet per prompt, guarded by fixed phrases: 'external service', 'name the state', 'checks or waits' in the planner; 'external service', 'in round one', 'major finding', 'checks or waits' in the critic. Draft planner bullet: '- A step that calls an external service (GitHub API, CI run, deploy) must name the state the call needs (e.g. run completed) and how the plan checks or waits for it first.' Draft critic bullet: '- In round one, raise a major finding when a step calls an external service (GitHub API, CI run, deploy) without naming the state it needs or how the plan checks or waits for it.'
decisions.reason: Short fixed phrases fit the byte room, and removing either bullet makes the test fail. The producer may adjust the wording to fit the limit and must keep the phrases the test asserts.

rejected.option: Assert the whole bullet text in the test.
rejected.why: It breaks on any wording edit, but the guarded phrases are the behavior.

decisions.choice: Update the two budget lines in docs/system-facts.md, and name this in the plan as a required consequence, not a scope widening.
decisions.reason: SYSTEM_FACTS is include_str of docs/system-facts.md, and the test system_facts_budgets_match_computed in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs fails when a line differs from the computed size. The file itself says to update the line, never the budget. Only the planner and critic lines change; the contract, reader, producer and verifier lines must stay as they are. This answers finding 3: the edit is two numbers, is forced by the prompt edit, and is not a design change.

rejected.why: cargo test --locked would fail on system_facts_budgets_match_computed.

decisions.reason: The brief lists it as evidence, records are out of scope, and the producer snapshot has no records/ directory. Athena handles its status.

files.purpose: Add the external-service state and wait bullet. Trim the last bullet and shorten the working-directory sentence so the file stays at or under 1497 bytes. Keep the phrases existing tests assert: 'seam, fake or fixture', 'Never put the logic under test inside the double', 'refusal_corpus'.
Add the round-one major-finding bullet. Trim the closing line and shorten the snapshot sentence so the file stays at or under 1497 bytes. Keep 'major finding when a demonstration names no seam'.
Add the unit test external_service_calls_need_a_named_state_and_a_wait to the tests module, next to reader_checks_for_governance_files_and_producer_stops_on_unlisted_ones.

Update the lines '- budget planner: 806 of 1300' and '- budget critic: 783 of 1300' to the new computed sizes. This is required by system_facts_budgets_match_computed and is a two-number edit. Other lines stay as they are.

Under Unreleased, record the convention: plans must name the state an external-service call needs and how they check or wait for it, and the critic rejects a plan missing it in round one. Cite failure class 20261018-100239-xc20 and introspections 20261018-100226-1mfq, 20261026-002830-390w and 20261026-091638-kqx6.

steps: Edit crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md: remove the last bullet 'End with the plan as structured output.', shorten the working-directory sentence, add the external-service bullet. Keep the file at or under 1497 bytes.
Edit crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md: remove the closing line, shorten the snapshot sentence, add the round-one major-finding bullet. Keep the file at or under 1497 bytes.
Run `cargo test -p athena-context planner_and_critic_frames_are_short_and_fit_the_budgets` and trim further if it fails.

Add the test external_service_calls_need_a_named_state_and_a_wait to crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs. It loops over the planner phrases and the critic phrases and asserts each with a message such as 'planner frame lacks: {phrase}'. Remove each bullet in turn to see the test fail, then restore it.

Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets`. If system_facts_budgets_match_computed fails, copy the computed planner and critic sizes into docs/system-facts.md and rerun. Leave the other lines as they are.
Add the CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`, then `git diff --stat` to confirm only the five listed files changed.

risks.risk: The new bullets push a frame to 500 or more estimated tokens (1500 bytes or more) and fail the frame test.
risks.mitigation: Run `cargo test -p athena-context planner_and_critic_frames_are_short_and_fit_the_budgets` after editing. Trim until each file is at most 1497 bytes and keep the phrases the tests assert.

risks.risk: The budget lines in docs/system-facts.md go stale.
risks.mitigation: Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets`. Its failure message prints the computed sizes; copy the planner and critic values into docs/system-facts.md and rerun.

risks.risk: Trimming breaks an existing assertion, for example planning_prompts_and_brief_require_a_named_test_seam in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs.
risks.mitigation: Keep the asserted phrases verbatim in both frames and run the full suite.

risks.risk: A reviewer treats the change as a matching rule that needs refusal_corpus cases.
risks.mitigation: The plan adds no refusal or matching rule, parser, stem list or stop list. The new text is prompt guidance guarded by a wording test, so no refusal_corpus case applies, and the producer should not edit the corpus.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the planner.md diff, then run the new test, which reads PLANNER_FRAME.text (an include_str of this file).
demonstrations.observes: The planner.md diff adds a bullet naming an external service (GitHub API, CI run, deploy), the state the call needs (e.g. run completed), and how the plan checks or waits for it before the call. The test passes on the planner phrases.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the critic.md diff, then run the new test, which reads CRITIC_FRAME.text.
demonstrations.observes: The critic.md diff adds a bullet saying to raise a major finding in round one when an external-service call omits the needed state or how the plan checks or waits for it. The test passes on the critic phrases.

demonstrations.method: A new unit test in the athena-context test module reads the public constants PLANNER_FRAME.text and CRITIC_FRAME.text. It loops over the required phrases and asserts each with a message naming the missing one ('planner frame lacks: ...', 'critic frame lacks: ...'). Both frames are static include_str text, so no precondition or guard applies. The producer also removes a bullet temporarily, sees the failure, and restores it.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes with both bullets. With the planner bullet removed it fails with 'planner frame lacks: ...'. With the critic bullet removed, or 'in round one' dropped from it, it fails with 'critic frame lacks: ...'.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the planner bullet, the critic bullet, or the words 'in round one' or 'major finding' from the critic bullet makes the matching assertion fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points: PLANNER_FRAME.text and CRITIC_FRAME.text in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs. They exist today (static include_str text, read in lib.rs). The fixture is the frame text itself, with no double. Plan step 4 adds the test.

demonstrations.method: Run the whole workspace suite. It includes planner_and_critic_frames_are_short_and_fit_the_budgets (each frame under 500 estimated tokens and inside its budget set), planning_prompts_and_brief_require_a_named_test_seam, planner_prompt_and_brief_carry_the_refusal_corpus_rule, and system_facts_budgets_match_computed in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs.
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass. Both frames stay under 500 estimated tokens. The planner and critic lines in docs/system-facts.md equal the computed sizes. The seam and refusal_corpus wording that existing tests assert survives the trim.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the trims, the frame-size test fails. Without the docs/system-facts.md update, system_facts_budgets_match_computed fails. If the trim removed asserted wording, the seam or refusal_corpus tests fail.
demonstrations.seam: Existing tests that call compose() and check_budget() in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs and computed_rows() in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs. All exist today (read in the code). No step adds a seam.

demonstrations.method: Run the budgets test, then check the diff and the lint commands. The budgets test computes the size of every prompt set from the real prompt files via computed_rows() and compares it to docs/system-facts.md. It passes only if the contract, reader, producer and verifier lines are unchanged and only the planner and critic lines moved, so a stray edit to another prompt would fail it. Then run `git diff --stat`, `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`.
demonstrations.observes: The budgets test passes with the contract, reader, producer and verifier lines at their base values (326, 1997, 1257, 1298 in the base snapshot). `git diff --stat` lists only planner.md, critic.md, the athena-context src/lib.rs test module, docs/system-facts.md (two numbers) and CHANGELOG.md. fmt and clippy report nothing. No records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow file appears in the diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: If any reader, producer, verifier or contract prompt were edited, its size would differ from its unchanged line in docs/system-facts.md and system_facts_budgets_match_computed would fail. An unformatted or lint-failing change fails fmt or clippy.
demonstrations.seam: Existing: computed_rows() in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs reads the real prompt files and docs/system-facts.md (it exists, read in the code). The fixture is the repository itself, with no double and nothing injected. No step adds it.

open_questions: docs/system-facts.md is not a listed deliverable, but the budgets test forces its two lines to change. The plan includes it; the verifier needs to accept it.
Trimming the planner's closing bullet and the snapshot sentences removes some wording. The producer should check that the planner and critic briefs and the contract still state the same facts.
Whether the critic acts on the new bullet is prose-only guidance; the test guards only the wording.
